nodes.label: Existing Architecture
nodes.rationale: Elastic Stack (free version) for storage, Logstash for detection, Redis for buffering alerts, Telegram bot for alerts and verification, and Imperva for IP blocking.

nodes.label: Tujuan Pengembangan ML
nodes.rationale: Convert SOC decisions into training labels, develop an ML decision engine for auto-block, shadow mode, and active learning, prioritizing safety and explainability.

nodes.label: Tabular Classification Approach
nodes.rationale: Supervised tabular classification using scikit-learn baseline and LightGBM/XGBoost for Decision Engine, not for detection.

nodes.label: Target Architecture
nodes.rationale: Logstash detects → Python builder makes event JSON + event_id → event indexed to ES + Redis → Redis consumed by Telegram notifier + ML shadow mode → SOC clicks stored as label → ML learns from SOC labels.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Foundation
nodes.rationale: Ensure all anomalies have a stable event_id, store all events and SOC click labels to Elasticsearch, and ensure events and labels can be joined for training.

nodes.label: Deterministic Event ID
nodes.rationale: Event ID is built from detector_type, asset_id, src_ip, time_bucket, and signature to ensure the same event in the same window has the same ID.

nodes.label: Telegram Callback Labeling
nodes.rationale: SOC decision buttons are parsed into action + event_id and stored in minisoar-labels-* index as ground truth labels.

nodes.label: Decision Logic
nodes.rationale: Thresholds for action based on p_block: p >= 0.98 -> AUTO BLOCK, 0.6 <= p < 0.98 -> SOC REVIEW, p < 0.6 -> AUTO ALLOW/IGNORE, with security guardrails.
